Seed=7 (evaluator default) which may have been well-tuned for this target.
current_paradigm.what_to_optimize: best_total_reward via sharper self-conditioning and cleaner noise schedule
current_paradigm.cautions: sc_scale_score=2.0 is aggressive - monitor for mode collapse. 1/t noise with p>1 effectively scales the noise; ensure p values stay in 0.05-8.0 range. Four hotspots provides good coverage without over-constraining.
